A FEW PRACTICAL DETAILS

Before you choose.

Can I subscribe today?

Not yet. These are proposed launch plans. The early-access links open an email to the Atomic team; they do not create an account, reserve a price, or start a subscription.

How many credits are included?

We are measuring generation, retries, and infrastructure costs before setting allowances. A credit is a usage unit, not a promise that every prompt has the same cost. Exact quantities, rates, expiry, and top-up rules will be published before purchase.

Is hosting included?

The included hosting allowance and any additional usage rates are still being defined. Do not assume unlimited traffic, storage, database usage, or app AI is included in the proposed subscription price.

Will there be annual billing?

Monthly pricing is the current proposal. Annual billing and discounts have not been announced.

What happens if I cancel?

Cancellation, credit expiry, data retention, export access, and the behavior of published apps will be specified in the final subscription terms before checkout becomes available.

Is Business available at launch?

Business is a planned later release. Team controls, support commitments, and its final feature set are not available for purchase on this website.
